audit.whatIsWrong: The page has Tahm Kench's ability slots wrong and one ability that no longer exists. (a) 'his W devour' and 'his 22-second W devour cooldown' in whys[3], content.mid and wants.you[1]: W is ABYSSAL DIVE at 21s; DEVOUR is his R. (b) 'Abyssal Voyage R' in content.late and wants.foe[1] — Abyssal Voyage is a REMOVED ultimate; his R is Devour, and it does not transport anyone anywhere. (c) whys[0] and content.early both state 'he has no stun'. Riot's Q text: 'If the champion already has 3 stacks of An Acquired Taste, they are stunned and the stacks are consumed.' He absolutely has a stun, from level 1.
audit.why: The 'no stun' claim is the dangerous one — it tells a melee champion to walk into the exact stack pattern that locks her down. And because Devour is his ULTIMATE, everything the early-game section says about him devouring you at levels 1-2 describes an ability he will not own for five more levels. The mirror flagged this same error class from the other side.
audit.corrected: whys[0], whys[1], whys[3], content.early, content.mid, content.late, wants.you[1] and wants.foe[1] all rewritten onto the real slots: Tongue Lash stuns on the third mark, Abyssal Dive is the 21-second escape, Thick Skin is the grey health, Devour is the level-6 ultimate.
sources: champ-data/_kits/tahmkench.json P/Q/W/E/R text, cooldowns and ranges

audit.whatIsWrong: Four separate strings (whys[4], spikes[1].text, wants.you[2], content.mid) promise that Wind Slash 'executes through grey health'. It does not.
audit.why: The mirror already corrected this from Tahm Kench's side: Wind Slash scales with the target's missing health and has no threshold, while Thick Skin's ACTIVE converts his stored damage into a temporary shield that absorbs incoming damage like any other shield. Grey health is not a bar Wind Slash bypasses — once he converts it, it is a shield standing in front of the health you were aiming at. A player told the execute goes through it will throw a 120-second ultimate into a shield.
audit.corrected: All four restated as: force the Thick Skin active out first, then execute what is underneath.
sources: champ-data/_kits/tahmkench.json E text and shield flag
mirrorFindings point 4 (Wind Slash scales with missing health, no threshold)

audit.whatIsWrong: The flagged needs-antiheal interaction never reaches the content layer despite BOTH Tongue Lash and Thick Skin carrying heal flags.
audit.why: Tongue Lash heals him off champions every 7 seconds at rank 1 and Thick Skin regenerates him out of combat. Grievous Wounds is the item that decides whether your chip damage stays gone, and it appears only in one encoding-damaged report line.
audit.corrected: The Tongue Lash heal and its 7-second cadence written into content.late.

edits.before: At level 1 he has no stun and his tongue lash Q has a readable wind-up — sidestep it and auto-Q poke freely. The danger is his Acquired Taste passive: three stacks of poke let him devour you for a disengage, so count the stacks and back off after two. The moment W comes online at level 2 you have the kill threat: E in, W stun, Q1-Q2-Q3 through him before the grey health converts. His only answer pre-3 is a slow devour that you can E out of the moment the animation starts.
edits.after: At level 1 his tongue lash has a readable wind-up — sidestep it and auto-Q poke freely, but count the marks: every Tongue Lash that lands stacks An Acquired Taste, and the third one STUNS you. Break the chain by dodging a lash before it lands that third mark. The moment W comes online at level 2 you have the kill threat: E in, Ki Burst, Q1-Q2-Q3 through him before Thick Skin converts the stored damage into a shield. Devour is his ultimate — he does not own it until 6, so nothing saves him here.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 are the flattest part of this lane — your burst is real but his grey-health passive starts absorbing meaningful damage, and his Q tongue lash has enough range to poke you off the wave if you play too far up. Play around his W devour cooldown (22 seconds): if he used it to eat a minion or escape a jungler, that is your window to E in and force the full combo. At level 6, Blade of the Exile changes the equation — Wind Slash executes through grey health, so the HP bar he thought was a safety buffer becomes your damage amplifier. Force the all-in the moment Exile is up and his W is on cooldown.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 are the flattest part of this lane — your burst is real but Thick Skin banks a share of everything you land, and Tongue Lash reaches 900 units to poke you off the wave if you stand too far up. Play around Abyssal Dive (21 seconds at rank 1): if he spent it diving a minion or escaping a jungler, that is your window to E in and force the full combo. At level 6 Blade of the Exile changes the maths: Wind Slash scales with his missing health, but a live Thick Skin shield absorbs it, so bait the active out before you throw the execute. Force the all-in with Exile up and Abyssal Dive down.

edits.before: Two-item Tahm Kench is a genuine wall — Heartsteel plus Warmog's or Sunfire means your combo deals real damage but he heals it back between the Q recharges, and his percent-HP grey-health sustain makes repeated poke trades worse for you than for him. Stop solo-diving him; instead shove the wave, roam on Abyssal Voyage windows (you can see it on the minimap), and set up a three-for-one: Q to build stacks on him, E in on the third, W stun, full Q chain, then detonate Wind Slash while teammates follow. He cannot devour an entire team.
edits.after: Two-item Tahm Kench is a genuine wall — Heartsteel plus Warmog's means your combo lands real damage, but Thick Skin banks it and Tongue Lash heals him back every 7 seconds, so repeated poke trades cost you more than they cost him. Bring Grievous Wounds or accept that nothing sticks. Stop solo-diving him; shove the wave and fight only alongside your team, because Devour eats exactly one champion for a few seconds — make sure the one it eats is not the one carrying. Bait the shield, then commit the chain and Wind Slash.

notes: This was the worst page in my slice. Tahm Kench's ability slots were wrong throughout — Devour repeatedly called his W and treated as a level-1 tool when it is his ultimate — and 'Abyssal Voyage', an ultimate that no longer exists, appeared twice as his current R. On top of that the page told the player twice that he has no stun, when Tongue Lash stuns on the third An Acquired Taste mark from level 1. I reused the mirror's Wind Slash finding rather than re-deriving it: the execute scales with missing health and has no threshold, and Thick Skin's converted shield absorbs it, so the four 'executes through grey health' promises all had to go.
